comments.author: @HomelandJourneys
comments.text: Being so close to the ocean while dealing with drought is the detail that caught my attention. I wonder how families get their fresh water and what habits children learn early to avoid wasting it. That everyday side of Baja deserves more attention.

replies.author: @ThePlanetJournalGlobe
replies.text: That paradox between the endless ocean and the harsh desert drought really struck us as well, @HomelandJourneys. Water conservation is essentially second nature for families there, relying heavily on water delivery trucks and strict daily rationing. Thank you for such an observant and thoughtful comment!
